thread:
ivy.design: Uploaded a compact-channel preview comp. Goals: single-line density, suppression discoverable, keyboard + SR parity. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ (frame: compact-preview)

ron.pm: Quick callout: inline pill or hover panel for suppression? Panel allows short helptext but might clip in narrow sidebars.

ivy.design: Prefer panel for clarity; fallback to pill when width constrained. Keyboard should open panel with Enter/Space on row.

mika.eng: We'll render panel in a portal to avoid clipping and keep z-index predictable. Use `aria-expanded` on opener and roving tabindex for row nav.

yasmin.a11y: For AT announce after content is present: "Preview opened for <channel>. Suppression: on/off." Use polite live region and update it ~60ms after mount to avoid announcing during animation.

faye.product: Copy debate: "Quiet window" vs "Snooze". Ops prefers quiet. Recommend a 3-task usability touch to decide.

ivy.design: I'll add both variants to the test frames and include short microcopy in the panel: "Silence this channel for a set time."

mika.eng: Toggle behavior: optimistic update + undo snackbar (6s). If API fails revert and show error toast. We'll emit analytics: preview_open, suppression_toggle, suppression_undo.

yasmin.a11y: Toasts should use `role="status"` and Undo must be focusable. Also increase badge contrast: BG #EEF2FF + FG #374151 and 3px focus ring token.

a11y-bot: Reminder: add `data-testid` on preview opener and suppression toggle for automated a11y smoke tests.

ivy.design: Handoff checklist: portal note, aria-live delay snippet, token swap for badge, optimistic toggle + undo, two wording variants for research. I will push updated frames and a dev checklist by EOD.
